owner_and_capability: Parent Portal owns its four-operation school settings port and optional batch snapshot read contract. The root translates the Settings public snapshot without exposing the provider implementation to the workflow. Partial Refs #4073 cut, not carrier completion. Parent Portal also owns the parent-request reason policy for submitting guardians and deciding staff, exposed as its RequestReasonPolicy value.
affected_tables: None: the same Settings owner resolves the same keys through the same tenant-scoped methods; no SQL or DDL change.
atomic_cutover: SettingsService, SettingsSnapshot and BatchSettingsService are consumer-owned. Root BindParentSettings adapts the optional owner batch method, preserves its context, tenant, requested keys, errors and nil snapshots, and delegates the same transaction lock/fresh reads. RequestReasonPolicy.RequiresReason moves the unchanged policy function and its full staff/guardian/unknown-value test table from Settings into the workflow. Six services/config keys fall: 281 -> 275, #4073 54 -> 48; rules 937 -> 937, composition 1664 -> 1664, portal compose budget 508 -> 507 and total 71706 -> 71705. No new grants or package moves. The workflow no longer imports services/config in any scope; the old production helper and its test file are moved, not left reachable only from tests.
tests: Pinned Go targeted workflow feature/reason/pickup tests and TestParentSettingsBindingPreservesBatchResults passed; complete non-fast scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development passed 66 packages on the integrated base, including portal/care and API/router golden. Existing assertions and fixture timeouts are unchanged.

The moved reason-policy table retains every assertion for staff and guardian sides, including empty and unknown values. scripts/check-deadcode.sh passes production, test and architecture-command modes after moving the old Settings helper.
